title: Sudoku Screenshot Coach
description: *Sudoku Screenshot Coach* is a **web tool** that takes a screenshot with a sudoku anywhere in it, finds the grid, reads the digits, and explains the **next best move** and why it is forced — in **English or Spanish**.

I directed the concept and the **architecture**: a **computer-vision pipeline** written from scratch (no OCR library) that ignores the player's pencil marks and repairs its own misreadings using the rules of sudoku, plus a coach that reasons with **13 human solving techniques** instead of a solver's answer.
The result teaches rather than spoils: every hint names the technique and the exact cells that force it. All pure logic is **TDD-covered** with Bun, and nothing leaves the browser.
